# Bananamen
A species of banana-shaped individuals who hail from the mythical "Banana Planet".
They have similar stats to a baseline human, but with the notable features of bleeding [color=#f8ff75]potassium[/color] and having organs consisting of [color=#f8ff75]solely bananas[/color]. A person will transform into a Bananaman upon ingesting 30u of [color=#f8ff75]Honk[/color]
## Bananamen Naming Conventions
Bananamen names typically are a singular word which is referential to the fruit they share similarities with. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Peel - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Slippy - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Chiquita - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Apple - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Annoying Orange
## Lore
Though the endless civil wars occurring on Banana Planet should, at a glance, warrant intervention from the Galactic Hegemony upon their world, there are numerous reasons that they have not. The main two however are as follows. Firstly, the Bananamen have developed enough weaponry that if intervention were to occur, it could lead to the total destruction of the Banana Planet. Secondly, the method of reproduction used by Bananamen is more akin to a viral infection than traditional copulation. These two factors have led to their extreme isolation, though rarely Banamen do find themselves in the galactic stage.
